name: vllm_gptq_marlin_moe_repack
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_gptq_marlin_moe_repack.py. Repacks per-expert GPTQ int32 weights into Marlin layout: b_q_weight (num_experts, K//pack_factor, N) int32 random (pack_factor=32//num_bits), perm (num_experts, K) int32 = identity arange broadcast over experts; size_k=K, size_n=N, num_bits in {4,8}. perm is a fixed identity pattern so gen_inputs builds both tensors (K read from declared perm width). Reference calls _custom_ops.gptq_marlin_moe_repack and returns the repacked tensor; the test compares the full int32 output exactly, which the default comparator reproduces. Requires vLLM at eval time.
